title: Exploring the Linear Subspace Hypothesis in Gender Bias Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to measure relative cosine similarity between target concepts (e.g., career/family, math/arts) and male/female attribute words. Also measured using a professions neighborhood task to quantify stereotyped associations (correlation of male neighbors to original bias) and an SVM classifier to predict gender for measuring indirect bias.
